title: Add organization policy overlay preview
verified: Organization policy overlays are explicitly preview-only until a future implementation task is approved.
Core local invariants no-shell, exact-approval, secret-handle, source-to-sink, audit and rollback are non-removable.
Overlay states are defined as absent, compatible, stricter, incompatible, unsigned and revoked.
Unsigned, revoked and incompatible overlays are visible blockers.
Policy broadening must be projected with authority_broadening=true, runtime_mediation_required=true and activation_blocked=true.
Future activation requires AgentCore PlanRun, exact approval, ecosystem replay and SecurityExecutionEngine commit with rollback evidence.
TUI remains a projection layer and may not activate overlays, sign overlays, clear blockers or mutate local policy files.
risk_notes: Overlay execution remains unimplemented in Console Beta.
Organization policy cannot override local safety invariants or become remote authority over local runtime behavior.
Policy broadening requires a future mediated activation flow and cannot bypass exact approval.
